values.note: $20 a night, with the fee and registration procedure posted at the campground kiosk. A Recreation Passport is required for vehicle entry to every state forest campground.

note: Secluded rustic campground in woodland along the Pigeon River in Pigeon River Country State Forest, ~13.5 mi E of Vanderbilt via Sturgeon Valley Rd and Twin Lakes Rd. Shingle Mill Pathway runs through it. --Claude
summary: DNR page + SF amenity table: $20, no electric, vault toilets, hand-pump water, first-come only, 15-day max, 14 sites (all confirmed, derived -> manual; the amenity table says 19). Season changed: derived year_round false ('Open spring-fall' in the note) -> year_round true (amenity table 'open all year', roads may not be plowed in winter). Not a horse camp: the amenity table types it 'rustic'; the nearby horse camps are separate rows (Elk Hill Equestrian River Trail Campground, Elk Hill Group Equestrian Campground, Johnson's Crossing Trail Camp), and nothing on its page mentions horses. Boilerplate 'tent and small trailer' wording, silent on length. Access via Sturgeon Valley Rd and Twin Lakes Rd, no road warning. Note trimmed of field restatements and the contradicted 'Open spring-fall'.
